title: The Client
author: John Grisham
summary: An eleven-year-old boy sees something he should not have seen and ends up with knowledge that the mob and the FBI both want. He hires a recovering-alcoholic lawyer to protect him.
readIf: you want a quick legal thriller anchored by a smart, scrappy kid and his unlikely lawyer.
skipIf: you dislike legal procedure or want a more realistic portrait of how child witnesses are treated.

pairings.reason: Another brisk Grisham thriller about a clever young person stuck between criminals and the law.
A more serious classic about a lawyer and a case seen partly through children's eyes.
A slower, more thoughtful courtroom novel for readers who enjoy the legal side more than the chase.
